question: Shipment SH-2051 (Vaccine A, lot L-A-07) logged 14 min at a max of 9.6 C in transit yesterday. Release, quarantine, destroy or escalate?
context:
[sop-temp-v3.md]
# Temperature excursion SOP, version 3

Apply in order. Step 1: freeze-sensitive product with any reading at or below 0.0 C -> DESTROY, no exceptions. Step 2: max at most 12.0 C AND at most 30 min AND the lot has at least 60 min of stability budget left before this excursion -> RELEASE (deduct the minutes from the lot budget). Step 3: anything else -> QUARANTINE pending QA review.

Owner: Quality Assurance.

[stab-a.md]
# Stability study, Vaccine A

Lots tolerate up to 100 cumulative minutes at 8-12 C over shelf life.

[memo_dec-138.md]
# Decision memo DEC-138 (2026-08-21)

Subject: SH-2016. Disposition: RELEASE.

5 min at 8.9 C, lot L-A-07 had 100 min left.

[memo_dec-131.md]
# Decision memo DEC-131 (2026-06-10)

Subject: SH-1975. Disposition: RELEASE.

18 min, max 9.9 C, lot L-A-02 had 100 min of budget left. Meets v3 release criteria. Stability report STAB-A reviewed.

answer.reason: The shipment meets the release criteria as it had 100 minutes of stability budget left and the temperature was below 12.0 C for less than 30 minutes.
